Eye Security is looking for an Office Manager to keep its The Hague office running smoothly. This role is central to daily operations, guest experience, and event support within a flat, fast-growing organization.  Wat ga je doen - Keep the office running day to day - Welcome guests and new colleagues - Work with the event manager on events - Remember important moments like work anniversaries - Follow up on reported problems until fixed - Manage vendors, service providers, and building management  Wat je meebrengt - Experience in office management, front office, facilities, or hospitality - Takes initiative and sets own priorities - Warm and approachable, natural host - Fluent in Dutch and English - Available 4 days a week in The Hague office, especially Thursdays - Available 32-40 hours per week  Wat je krijgt - Real ownership of office and events - Flat organisation with close founder contact - Company retreats abroad - Generous time-off policy including wellbeing and volunteering days - Room to grow with the team  Over Eye Security Eye Security is a flat organisation where employees have close contact with the founders. Samenvatting door Personeel.com. De volledige vacaturetekst en het sollicitatieformulier staan op de website van Eye Security (jobs.ashbyhq.com); met Solliciteer ga je er direct heen.

As a Truck Mechanic / Service Technician, you will play an important role in keeping a modern fleet safe, reliable and ready for operation. Your responsibilities include:• Performing maintenance and repairs• Diagnosing and solving technical faults• Working on hydraulic, mechanical and vehicle systems• Preparing vehicles and equipment for daily use• Occasionally carrying out service work at external locations You will work in a professional and supportive team where quality, safety, teamwork and personal development are highly valued. With dedication and motivation, you can grow into a skilled mechanic with excellent long-term career prospects. The gross monthly salary ranges from €3,171.82 to €4,173.91, depending on your skills, knowledge and experience. As your responsibilities and technical abilities grow, there are opportunities for further salary development. Accommodation is available for international candidates. You will have a private bedroom and access to shared facilities, including a kitchen, bathroom and other common areas. Our workshop has an international team, and colleagues communicate in English, Dutch, German, Romanian and Arabic. Basic communication with at least one colleague is sufficient. Ready for a new challenge and a stable future in a growing technical profession? Apply today and become part of our team.You can send your application to: tim.kersten@uwv.nl Applications from non-EU/EEA or Swiss nationalities will not be considered.
